title: search
description: Ranked, grouped search over the workspace — replaces grep, glob and find (SDD 9.1). Lexical, structural, references and files modes are live; semantic is reserved and rejected in v1 with a typed error, never a schema failure.

query.description: Text or regex (lexical), an ast-grep pattern with $VAR metavariables (structural), an identifier (references), or a glob/filename fragment (files mode).

mode.description: auto escalates from lexical as index tiers allow. semantic is reserved — accepted by this schema and rejected by the tool with a typed error (SDD 1.1).

kind.description: Optional structural filter over matched node kinds, e.g. ["function","call"] ("call" matches "call_expression"). In Rust, method calls are call_expression too; item kinds end in _item (function_item, impl_item, trait_item, struct_item, enum_item); macros are macro_invocation. Advisory in lexical mode (kind-tags ranking only).

path.description: Glob scope over workspace-relative paths, e.g. src/**.

include.description: Ranking demotes tests and vendor by default; an explicit false here excludes them entirely.
